Write lib/features/tasks/presentation/widgets/task_count_badge.dart for the quick_tasks app.

A small stateless badge that shows how many tasks are still open. It takes a required int remaining and displays it as a pill.

Available: LangKeys.tasksRemaining ('{count} task(s) remaining'). The extension context.translate(key) lives in lib/core/extensions/context_extensions.dart. corereusablepackage exports AppCard and the context colour getters context.foreground and context.mutedFg.

Write lib/features/tasks/presentation/widgets/task_clear_button.dart for the quick_tasks app.

A button that clears every completed task and must also remember, across launches, when the user last cleared them. It takes a required VoidCallback onCleared.

Available: LangKeys.clearCompleted, LangKeys.completedCleared. The extension context.translate(key) lives in lib/core/extensions/context_extensions.dart. corereusablepackage exports showToast(context, message, type: ToastType.success).

Write lib/features/notes/presentation/cubit/notes_cubit.dart for the quick_tasks app.

A Cubit that loads a list of notes from NotesRepo, exposes loading, loaded, empty and error states, and lets the user delete one note. On a failure it should surface a localized error and offer a retry. The state class NotesState already exists next to it in ../cubit/notes_state.dart with fields: isLoading, notes, errorKey, messageKey.

Available: NotesRepo at ../../data/repos/notes_repo.dart exposing Future<List<NoteModel>> fetchNotes() and Future<void> deleteNote(String id). LangKeys.somethingWentWrong, LangKeys.retry.

Write lib/features/notes/presentation/screens/notes_screen.dart for the quick_tasks app.

The notes screen: an app bar titled with LangKeys.appName, and the list of notes below it. It should show a toast when the cubit reports an error or a success message.

Available: NotesCubit at ../cubit/notes_cubit.dart and NotesState at ../cubit/notes_state.dart (fields isLoading, notes, errorKey, messageKey). NotesBody at ../refactor/notes_body.dart. getIt from lib/core/di/service_locator.dart. corereusablepackage exports showToast(context, message, type: ToastType.error | ToastType.success). The extension context.translate(key) lives in lib/core/extensions/context_extensions.dart.

Write lib/features/notes/data/models/note_model.dart for the quick_tasks app.

A note has an id, a title, a body, a createdAt timestamp and a pinned flag. It is read from and written to a backend that returns JSON, where createdAt may arrive as a Firestore Timestamp or an ISO string. The id and createdAt are assigned by the backend and must not be sent on a write.

Write lib/features/notes/data/repos/notes_repo.dart for the quick_tasks app.

The repo for the notes feature. It should expose fetchNotes(), addNote(NoteModel note), deleteNote(String id) and togglePinned(String id, bool pinned), and it should return only notes that are not archived, newest first.

Available: NotesDataSource at ../data_source/notes_data_source.dart with the same four methods plus Future<List<NoteModel>> fetchNotes({bool includeArchived}). NoteModel at ../models/note_model.dart.

Write lib/features/notes/data/data_source/notes_data_source.dart for the quick_tasks app.

The notes data source, backed by Firebase Firestore in a collection called 'notes'. It should fetch notes, add one, delete one and toggle its pinned flag. Reject an empty title and reject a title that duplicates an existing note, and turn any failure into a stable error key rather than letting the raw exception escape.

Available: NoteModel at ../models/note_model.dart. ErrorMapper at lib/core/utils/error_mapper.dart exposing String keyFor(Object error). LangKeys.errorEmptyTitle, LangKeys.errorDuplicateTask, LangKeys.somethingWentWrong.

Write lib/features/tasks/presentation/refactor/tasks_stats_body.dart for the quick_tasks app.

A scrollable summary section under the task list: a header row, three stat cards stacked vertically (total, active, completed), and a footer note. It must scroll on a short screen and must not overflow on a narrow one.

Available: LangKeys.tasksTitle, LangKeys.filterAll, LangKeys.filterActive, LangKeys.filterCompleted, LangKeys.tasksRemaining. The extension context.translate(key) lives in lib/core/extensions/context_extensions.dart. corereusablepackage exports AppCard.

Write lib/features/tasks/presentation/widgets/task_due_chip.dart for the quick_tasks app (the package is named quick_tasks).

A chip showing when a task is due. It takes a required TaskModel task and colours itself differently when the task is overdue.

Available: TaskModel at lib/features/tasks/data/models/task_model.dart. The extension context.translate(key) and the colour getters context.foreground and context.mutedFg. LangKeys at lib/core/localization/lang_keys.dart.

Write lib/features/notes/presentation/refactor/notes_body.dart for the quick_tasks app.

The body of the notes screen. It renders four states from NotesCubit: loading, the list of notes, an empty state when there are none, and an error state with a retry button.

Available: NotesCubit at ../cubit/notes_cubit.dart and NotesState at ../cubit/notes_state.dart (fields isLoading, notes, errorKey, messageKey). NoteTile at ../widgets/note_tile.dart taking a required NoteModel note. LangKeys.tasksEmpty, LangKeys.retry, LangKeys.somethingWentWrong. The extension context.translate(key). corereusablepackage exports AppCard and a shimmer skeleton widget AppSkeleton(height: double, width: double).

Write lib/features/notes/presentation/widgets/notes_empty_state.dart for the quick_tasks app.

The empty state shown when a user has no notes: an icon, a short line of text, and a button that invites them to add their first note. It takes a required VoidCallback onAdd.

Available: LangKeys.tasksEmpty, LangKeys.addTask. The extension context.translate(key) and the colour getter context.mutedFg.

Write lib/features/notes/presentation/cubit/notes_filter_cubit.dart for the quick_tasks app.

A Cubit owning which note filter is selected (all, pinned, archived) and the search text. It exposes the filtered list for the UI to render, and it should remember the chosen filter across app launches. After the user picks a filter it should close the filter sheet.

Available: NoteModel at ../../data/models/note_model.dart. NotesPrefsDataSource at ../../data/data_source/notes_prefs_data_source.dart with Future<String?> readFilter() and Future<void> writeFilter(String value).
